basic_profile.bio: I'm a 47-year-old software developer from Birmingham, UK, who recently decided to take control of my life by quitting porn. I've always been passionate about football, specifically Aston Villa, and I often engage with the AVFC community on Reddit. Outside of tech and football, I enjoy gardening and am slowly learning to play the guitar. My typical online hours are in the evening after work. I work from home most days, which allows me to manage my time flexibly. Currently, I'm single and focusing on self-improvement and building healthier habits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over 20 years in the tech industry, I have a deep understanding of software development and IT solutions. My knowledge is continuously updated through online courses and tech forums. I also have a growing interest in psychology, especially related to habits and addiction.
